new_finding.summary: Kubernetes --infra context parsing truncates slash-containing context names in the conflict check, while the actual target parser retains the whole context.

confirmed_cases.observed_problem: conflict is missed and target proof can describe a different context

new_finding.repair: Use the canonical context_from_infra parser and cover both matching multi-segment contexts and conflicting prefixes.

review_scope: Read-only source review; reviewer ran no tests and did not verify live endpoints, provider schema or CI.

post_repair_review.claude_scope: Initial and follow-up Claude reviews completed; the follow-up reviewed v6 and resolved the seven earlier findings and H1-H3, then found the slash-context defect. Claude did not directly review v7.
post_repair_review.final_fix_review: Independent Codex source review and nine passing regression controls; restoring the old helper rejected all eight distinguishing cases. The coordinating agent also reviewed the patch.
post_repair_review.final_fix_live: Nine actual Kubernetes cases at the parser-fix producer include the changed planner and pre-probe context refusal; the final documentation-only successor has identical runtime bytes.

remaining_scope_notes: Expected deployment-manifest comparison reuses the observed bootstrap timestamp; it is not an independent timestamp assertion. Deployed module-byte comparisons remain separate evidence.
Trusting the current self-signed agent certificate is verified; a future private-CA deployment would need the appropriate chain.
Ordinary Git worktree files are supported. No further local-config execution path under the hardened raw-object environment was identified by this review.
